title: Return Rifts
subtitle: The way home, while the fuel lasts
text:
There is no gate on the far side. The gate you left from holds a rift open beside the spot where you land. Walk into it to go back.

Holding the rift open costs the gate energy every second and an Entangled Pellet every minute, from its own buffer and pellet slots. Keep the gate powered and stocked while you are away. Richer worlds cost more to hold.

A counter at the top of the screen shows how long the fuel will hold the rift open. You see it on the far side and near the gate. It counts the energy and the pellets the gate has left, whichever runs out first.

When the fuel is nearly gone the counter turns red and flashes, and the rift flickers and sparks. When it runs out, the rift collapses and you are stranded.

If the ship leaves the system while you are still out there, the rift is gone as well. If you were logged out at the time, you are brought back to the gate when you next join.

The rift closes by itself once everyone who came through has gone back. Close Rift on the gate drops it at once.
